overview.description: The Future Fund Long/Short ETF (FFLS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long/short alternatives. The fund is actively managed to provide long/short exposure to US-listed stocks that benefit from emerging secular trends driven by technological, social, and environmental changes. The fund aims to pursue capital appreciation. FFLS was launched on Jun 20, 2023 and is issued by The Future Fund.
